subject: Count sign-up and login limits per visitor, not per Cloudflare server
body:
Render puts every site behind Cloudflare, so the server was seeing a
Cloudflare address instead of the customer's. That meant the 5-signups-
an-hour limit and failed-login lockouts were shared by everyone coming
through the same Cloudflare server, so real customers could block each
other. The server now reads the visitor's real address from the
CF-Connecting-IP header Cloudflare adds. The sign-in log and back office
show real customer addresses from now on.
